canonical_title: Escape exits and routes – tactical air vehicles
subject_group: 9.6.3 Emergency ground, ditching, and water egress

versions.title_at_revision: Escape exits and routes – tactical air vehicles
versions.text:
Standard: Crewmembers can egress from tactical air vehicles within 30 seconds under day and night lighting conditions. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Ground or Lab test: Show that the egress time meets requirements under both day and night lighting conditions. Testing is accomplished using participants representative of the intended anthropometric population wearing required worst-case crewmember equipment. Tests are accomplished using an air vehicle or high-fidelity mockup.
